name: shell-impl
description: The shell@1 provider `local-bash`: runs ONE command string through a LOCAL shell. The ONLY transport of this repository that executes on the workbench HOST, hence the explicit execution/policies declaration below.

config.description: Local shell of `general-service` type `local`: { shell, binary, cwd, timeoutMs, maxOutputBytes, env }.

cwd.description: Working directory of the command (default: the host process' own)

env.description: Extra environment for the child process
